name: faraz-claude-plugins
description: Faraz's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace — opinionated plugins for spinning up dev environments, scaffolding stacks, and automating local-first workflows.

plugins.name: create-t3-app-local
plugins.description: Zero-input local install of an opinionated T3 stack (Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, tRPC, Drizzle, better-auth) wired to a shared local Postgres (Homebrew postgresql@16) with per-project isolated databases and least-privilege roles. Ships a project-aware MCP server (auto-registered via the plugin manifest) so Claude Desktop and Cowork can query each project's DB. No manual prompts — runs end-to-end on macOS or Linux.

plugins.name: setup-claude-md-index
plugins.description: Scaffold CLAUDE.md in the current folder as a strict index pointing to per-topic detail files in .claude/topics/. Enforces an index-only CLAUDE.md with rules for adding, splitting, and merging topics; migrates any existing inline content into topic files.
